title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1994-10-19
lineage: Tascam DA-20MKII > Tascam HD-P2 > CF card > usb 2.0 > pc > r8brain v1.9 (resample to 44.1 kHz) > WaveLab 5.01b (fades, patch) > CD Wave v1.95.1 > FLAC v1.1.4 (Level 8)
source: AKG 460B/ck61 > custom pre-amp > Sony D7 (@ 48 kHz)

ai_review.summary: Excellent, clean sound captures a very good show highlighted by a spectacular Stella Blue → Sugar Magnolia segue and Jerry’s hot performance on Bertha.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the clear, pleasant audio and praise Jerry’s playing – from an “off‑the‑charts” ending on Stella Blue to a scorching vocal on Bertha. The show isn’t called legendary, but the SB→SM transition is singled out as spectacular, making this a very enjoyable recording overall.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews highlight strong performance and clean sound; limited sample size keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as "nice" with no complaints about muddiness, drop‑outs or balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows well, especially the Stella Blue → Sugar Magnolia transition which is praised as spectacular; overall a very good performance despite not being called "incredible".

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple mentions of Jerry ‘going off’ on Stella Blue and being ‘hot’ while singing Bertha, indicating standout guitar work and vocals.
